title: The pact
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, foggy small American town, cold blue and amber tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 3. The oldest woman in Harlow Creek finally explains the doors. 🕯️

Original fiction. Part 4 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Jenna locked her door in Harlow Creek. At 3:12, it unlocked itself. From the outside.
scenes.image: an open motel room door at night with fog drifting in, a woman frozen in the doorway

scenes.narration: She didn't sleep. At sunrise she knocked on the only door in town that was closed. Mrs. Edith Pruitt. Ninety-four years old.
scenes.image: old Victorian house at dawn, the only house on the street with its front door shut, a young woman on the porch

scenes.narration: Mrs. Pruitt didn't ask who she was. She just said: you locked it, didn't you? Come in. Quickly.
scenes.image: very old woman with white hair holding a door half open, her face lit by an oil lamp, cluttered dark parlor behind her

scenes.narration: In 1911, she said, something came to Harlow Creek. The town called it the Guest. It walked from house to house at night. And it took whatever was behind a locked door.
scenes.image: old sepia-toned photograph of a small 1911 town main street, townspeople standing stiffly, one blurred tall figure among them

scenes.narration: So the town made a pact. Every door stays open. The Guest passes through, takes nothing, and moves on. Every night. For a hundred years.
scenes.image: a row of old houses at night with every door open, a long shadow stretching across all the porches

scenes.narration: The Mercers didn't know. And now, she said, the Guest knows your name.
scenes.image: close-up of the old woman's eyes in lamplight, her face deeply lined and afraid

scenes.narration: Jenna asked why Mrs. Pruitt's own door was shut. The old woman smiled. Because I'm the one who keeps the list.
scenes.image: a leather-bound ledger open on a wooden table, handwritten names in faded ink, oil lamp beside it

scenes.narration: Outside, in the middle of the morning, the porch light flickered. Then the next one down the street went dark.
scenes.image: small town street in grey morning fog, porch lights going out one by one in a line

scenes.narration: And the next. And the next. Coming toward them.
scenes.image: view from inside a dark parlor window, porch lights going dark down the street toward the house, a shape in the fog
